key_impacts: Accident damaged Fukushima Daiichi plant, initiating long-term decommissioning.
Site entered an emergency situation that was later stabilized.
Large volumes of contaminated water required treatment and on-site storage.
evidence_snippets: accident at TEPCO’s Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station (NPS) on 11 March 2011
Since March 2011, addressing the damaged Fukushima Daiichi plants, moving from an emergency situation to a stabilized situation.
As of October 2018, about 1,100,000 m3 of treated water is stored on-site.
missing_information: Casualty and offsite impact details not provided.
